settings.sourceComposition: close chest-mounted first-person battlefield framing; avoid panoramic battlefield presentation
settings.visualStyle: Grounded historical reconstruction of the Battle of Guandu, 200 CE, experienced only from a chest-mounted first-person perspective of an ordinary infantryman in Cao Cao's army. The frame remains close to nearby soldiers, shields, spear shafts, earthworks, dust, smoke, churned mud and broken wooden defenses. Serious sustained fighting with restricted visibility, fatigue, unstable footing and physical pressure. No wuxia, no fantasy, no superhero generals, no game HUD, no centered FPS weapon and no cinematic battlefield showcase.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Every scene uses chest-mounted first-person POV. Scene N end state must physically equal Scene N+1 start state. Nearby soldiers behave independently and frequently obstruct the frame. The POV owner is never shown externally.

visibleElementsOnlyWhenNatural: spear or ji shaft at frame edge
belt or lamellar edge when body folds or falls
boots only when the torso angles sharply downward
povBodyMaster.outfit: plain late Eastern Han common-infantry tunic and trousers in muted earth tones, simple practical lamellar or leather protection, field-worn belt and basic footwear

caoArmy.appearance: late Eastern Han infantry with practical variation in cloth, leather and lamellar protection; muted colors; simple banners; shields, spears, ji, bows and crossbows
caoArmy.behavior: trained but exhausted infantry using formation, earthworks, shield pressure, short pushes and cover; no heroic posing

yuanArmy.appearance: late Eastern Han military equipment of the same broad era with different banner groupings and opposing positions; no fantasy color coding
yuanArmy.behavior: organized opposing infantry, crossbowmen, archers and limited cavalry support; usually only partly visible through dust, bodies and defenses

rules: Most soldiers are not attacking at the exact same moment.
Men seek cover, hesitate, stumble, compress formation and lose visibility.
Missile fire forces shields up and bodies low.
Close combat is brief, crowded and confusing rather than elegant dueling.
Cavalry is glimpsed through gaps and dust rather than shown as a clean panoramic charge.
The POV may fall, kneel, stop, lose sight, be shoved sideways or retreat a few steps when pressure becomes overwhelming.
No graphic gore; injury is implied through collapse, dragging and loss of movement.
Every scene prioritizes immediate human survival over battlefield spectacle.

movie.plotDetails: An anonymous infantryman in Cao Cao's army experiences a sustained frontline engagement during the Battle of Guandu in 200 CE. The entire episode remains inside the physical pressure of the fighting line. The viewer never receives a privileged battlefield overview; the soldier understands only what is directly around him.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a continuous two-minute serious battlefield POV episode set during the Battle of Guandu in 200 CE. Every scene must be chest-mounted first-person POV from an ordinary infantryman in Cao Cao's army. Keep the frame close to nearby backs, shoulders, shields, spear shafts, earthworks, dust, smoke, mud, broken stakes and bodies pressing through the formation. Do not show panoramic battlefield views. Begin crouched behind frontline earthworks under arrows, make a short push across churned ground, endure missile pressure, shelter beside crossbowmen, enter an uneven shield crush, descend toward a ditch, squeeze through broken palisade cover, experience a brief crowded spear clash, survive an enemy counterpush, catch only partial glimpses of cavalry through dust and nearby bodies, get knocked down, recover behind an earth mound, join a second short push, force through a narrow breach and end holding ground in smoke at dusk. No fantasy, no wuxia, no legendary hero focus, no clean choreography, no narration, no dialogue and no music.
movie.storySummary: Already under fire at Guandu, the POV soldier stays low behind an earthwork before moving with a crowded infantry group. Incoming arrows force shields up, friendly crossbowmen fire through gaps, and the line compresses until the soldier can see little beyond nearby armor, wood and dust. He reaches a ditch and broken palisade, survives a brief close clash and an enemy counterpush, catches only fragmented cavalry movement through smoke, is knocked to the ground, recovers behind cover, then joins another short push through a narrow breach. The episode ends inside a smoky contested position at dusk with no clean sense of victory.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Serious late Eastern Han battlefield chest-mounted POV at Guandu, 200 CE. Human-scale, close, crowded, partially obstructed and physically exhausting. No fantasy or theatrical martial arts.
movie.storyTitle: EP02 — Battle of Guandu, 200 CE: Hold the Line

povSubject.name: Anonymous Cao Infantryman
povSubject.cameraRelation: camera fixed at upper chest; viewer experiences the battle through this soldier's body position and movement

scenes.title: Already Under Fire
scenes.description: The episode opens already inside the frontline position with arrows striking nearby cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The chest-mounted POV is crouched shoulder-to-shoulder behind packed earth and rough timber. Nearby men keep low while arrows strike dirt and shields. A shoulder repeatedly blocks part of the view.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV from inside a cramped Cao infantry earthwork at Guandu, sternum-height camera, nearby backs and shoulders filling foreground, shield rims and spear shafts crossing frame edges, packed earth inches away, arrows striking dirt and wood, dust hanging in air, no wide battlefield view, serious historical realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: Chest-mounted first-person POV only. Start already crouched inside the line with men less than two meters away. A nearby shoulder and shield partly obstruct the frame. One or two arrows strike dirt and timber; the body flinches and braces. Do not reveal the battlefield. Camera movement comes only from breathing, crouching and body impact. No centered weapon, no heroic framing, no smooth camera. Audio: close breathing, wood impacts, dirt, armor scrape, distant drums and indistinct shouting.

continuityEndFrame.nearbySoldiers: one man begins moving through a narrow gap

scenes.title: Short Push From Cover
scenes.description: The soldier leaves the earthwork with the men immediately in front of him, seeing almost nothing beyond their backs.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rises, follows two men through a narrow gap and advances only a few meters before slowing behind their shields.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV directly behind two late Eastern Han infantrymen, their backs and shields dominating the frame, churned mud and broken stakes visible below, spear shafts close to lens, smoke and dust ahead but no panoramic battlefield view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Continue from the earthwork. Rise with the torso and move only a few meters behind two soldiers. Their backs occupy most of the frame. The camera jolts with each step and briefly bumps sideways when another soldier presses past. Stop behind their shields rather than continuing a heroic charge. No wide shot, no smooth tracking, no centered weapon. Audio: boots in churned earth, breathing, shields rubbing, nearby gear and distant arrows.

continuityEndFrame.shield: raised by soldier ahead blocks center

scenes.title: Volley at Chest Height
scenes.description: Incoming arrows force the body lower while nearby shields close over the field of view.
scenes.actionDescription: Several arrows arrive unevenly. The POV drops into a shallow depression while another soldier's shield fills much of the upper frame.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV crouching into a shallow battlefield depression, large wooden shield and nearby soldier's shoulder blocking most of view, arrow shafts striking ground and wood close by, dust hitting lower frame, no enemy panorama.
scenes.videoPrompt: Chest-mounted body-camera realism. A loose arrow volley arrives unpredictably. Drop quickly with the whole torso into a shallow depression. Let another soldier's shield obscure much of the view. The frame should feel cramped, confusing and defensive. No cinematic anticipation and no clean view of enemy ranks. Audio: arrows, shield impacts, grit, strained breathing and feet sliding in dirt.

continuityEndFrame.visibility: mostly blocked by shield and shoulder

scenes.title: Crossbows Beside You
scenes.description: Friendly crossbowmen fire from close beside the POV rather than being displayed in a broad firing line.
scenes.actionDescription: One crossbowman kneels almost shoulder-to-shoulder with the POV and fires through a narrow gap while another reloads behind him.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV inside a cramped depression beside two kneeling Cao crossbowmen, one shoulder and wooden crossbow close to camera edge, shields and dirt walls surrounding frame, only a narrow forward gap visible through dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Stay crouched. One crossbowman moves close enough that his shoulder and weapon cross the frame. He rises slightly, fires through a narrow gap, then drops. A second man reloads behind him. Keep the battlefield hidden by bodies and earth. No broad firing line, no synchronized volley, no wide shot. Audio: crossbow snap, breathing, wood, dirt and distant battle.

scenes.title: Shield Line Closes
scenes.description: The infantry compresses around the POV until shields, shoulders and spear shafts dominate the frame.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV moves into a crowded shield line. Men press from both sides, shield rims collide and the body is pushed forward a step at a time.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV trapped inside a dense uneven shield line, nearby armored backs and shoulders filling foreground, overlapping wooden shields inches from camera, spear and ji shafts crossing close to frame edges, mud and dust below, almost no wide battlefield visibility.
scenes.videoPrompt: Chest-mounted first-person POV from inside a crowded shield wall. Advance only a short distance while being pushed by men behind. Show shield rims, spear shafts, shoulders and backs filling most of the frame. Camera jolts from body contact and unstable footing in churned mud. Keep visibility claustrophobic and incomplete. Do not reveal the whole battlefield. No third-person angle, no wide cinematic shot, no heroic framing. Audio: heavy breathing, shield scraping, spear shafts rattling, boots in mud, arrows striking wood and indistinct shouting.

scenes.title: At the Ditch Lip
scenes.description: The line reaches a ditch where footing collapses and the view drops sharply toward the ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier ahead drops into the ditch. The POV is shoved forward, catches balance on a shield edge and steps down awkwardly.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV at a rough battlefield ditch, foreground dominated by nearby backs, shield edges and dirt wall, boots slipping on loose soil, broken stakes close by, no elevated view of enemy position.
scenes.videoPrompt: The body-mounted camera tips downward as the soldier ahead drops into the ditch. The POV is bumped from behind, stumbles, catches balance and descends awkwardly. Keep the view on close dirt, shields, legs and wooden stakes rather than a battlefield overview. Audio: soil sliding, armor knocks, breathing, shield scrape and nearby shouts.

continuityEndFrame.nearbySoldiers: one ahead crouched, one behind descending
continuityEndFrame.visibility: dirt walls, shield edges, palisade fragments

scenes.title: Under the Palisade
scenes.description: The POV crawls and squeezes beneath broken defensive timber while missiles continue overhead.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV crouch-walks under splintered timber behind another soldier, briefly using one hand against the earth wall for balance.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV low inside a battlefield ditch beneath broken wooden palisade, rough earth and splintered timber very close to lens, another soldier's back filling center, one sleeve and hand bracing at frame edge, dust and shadow, no wide view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Move low behind the man directly ahead. Timber and earth should repeatedly pass close to the chest-mounted camera. Brace one hand on the wall, duck under a splintered beam and pause when an impact sounds above. No smooth crawling shot, no dramatic reveal beyond the palisade. Audio: wood creak, dirt, breath, armor scrape and missile impacts overhead.

scenes.title: Spear Crush
scenes.description: A brief close clash is experienced as bodies, shields and weapon shafts colliding at arm's length.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is pushed into a brief clash. The shield edge rises, a spear shaft crosses close, and enemy figures appear only in fragments through shoulders and smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV in a cramped palisade breach, foreground packed with friendly shoulders, shields and spear shafts, fragmented opposing infantry only briefly visible through a narrow gap, dust and smoke, no clean duel, no wide battlefield view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Keep the camera trapped inside the crush. The POV braces behind a shield while spear and ji shafts cross close to the chest. Enemy figures appear only for a second through gaps and disappear behind bodies. No martial-arts exchange, no sword duel, no heroic kill shot. Use body impacts, brief backward recoil and restricted visibility. Audio: wood, metal, grunts, breath and confused shouting.

scenes.title: Counterpush
scenes.description: The enemy pressure forces the group backward several steps without revealing the wider battle.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is shoved backward by friendly soldiers retreating under pressure, almost loses footing and turns the torso to avoid a falling man.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV backing through a congested breach, friendly soldiers pressing backward into frame, shield corners and armor inches from lens, a falling body partly crossing lower frame, smoke and dust blocking distance.
scenes.videoPrompt: Do not show a broad counterattack. Experience it only as pressure from the people around the POV. Take two or three backward steps, get bumped hard from the side, turn the torso around a falling soldier and almost lose balance. Enemy remains mostly hidden. Audio: breath, shield impacts, shouting, feet sliding and wood cracking.

scenes.title: Cavalry Through Dust
scenes.description: Cavalry is glimpsed only through a momentary opening between nearby infantry and drifting dust.
scenes.actionDescription: While recovering balance, the POV turns with the torso and briefly sees horse legs and riders crossing a dusty flank through a gap before other soldiers block the view again.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV behind crowded infantry, brief narrow gap revealing only partial horse legs, riders and dust at medium distance, foreground shoulders and shields dominating most of frame, no panoramic cavalry charge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Turn the torso briefly toward a gap in the formation. Show only fragmented cavalry movement through dust: horse legs, a rider passing, banners partly visible. Immediately let nearby soldiers block the view again. Never show a clean full charge or wide cavalry panorama. Audio: hoofbeats through dust, close breathing, nearby armor and continued battle.

scenes.title: Knocked Down
scenes.description: A nearby impact and collision throw the POV to the ground, reducing the world to boots, mud and shield edges.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is struck sideways by another soldier during an impact, falls hard and briefly sees only ground-level movement before trying to rise.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV fallen sideways in churned mud, boots and lower legs rushing past close to lens, shield edge and hand in foreground, dust and grit, almost no horizon visible, intense human-scale battlefield realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: A nearby impact or collision throws the body sideways. The chest-mounted camera drops abruptly to ground level. For several seconds show mud, boots, lower legs, shield edges and dust rather than the battle itself. One hand presses into the ground as the POV tries to recover. No cinematic tumble, no slow motion. Audio: impact, breath knocked out, boots, dirt and muffled battle.

continuityEndFrame.body: on side starting to push up

scenes.title: Behind the Earth Mound
scenes.description: The soldier crawls a short distance into cover and struggles to recover his breath.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV pushes up, crawls only a short distance and folds behind an earth mound where other tired soldiers are already crouched.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV low behind a packed earth mound, close foreground of dirt, sleeve and shield edge, exhausted soldiers crouched within one or two meters, smoke above cover, no wide battlefield view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Recover from the fall with a short crawl into cover. Keep the camera low and close to dirt. Once behind the mound, pause and breathe hard while nearby soldiers fill the frame. One man checks his shield; another looks toward the front but does not pose. No scenic overview. Audio: heavy breathing, dirt, gear, arrows and distant shouts.

scenes.title: Second Short Push
scenes.description: The POV joins a second advance but remains close behind bodies and shields rather than seeing a broad counterattack.
scenes.actionDescription: Crossbow bolts pass overhead from behind as three nearby infantrymen rise and the POV follows them only a few meters toward the breach.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV following three Cao infantrymen from close behind, their backs and shields dominating the frame, crossbow bolts passing overhead, smoke and broken defenses ahead only partly visible between bodies.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rise from the mound behind three nearby soldiers. Advance only a few meters. Keep their backs, armor and shields close in frame. Friendly crossbow bolts pass overhead but never become a spectacle. The camera jolts with heavy breathing and tired footing. Stop when the men ahead halt. No wide counterattack shot, no heroic rush.

scenes.title: Narrow Breach
scenes.description: The group forces through a cramped opening where the POV can only see fragments of the opposing side.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the soldier immediately ahead through a narrow opening, braces a shield at frame edge and is squeezed sideways between timber and bodies.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV squeezing through a broken timber breach, wooden posts inches from lens, friendly shoulder filling one side, shield edge filling the other, brief opposing infantry fragment visible through smoke, no clean duel and no open battlefield view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Enter the breach one body at a time. Timber scrapes close to the chest camera. The soldier ahead blocks most of the view. Briefly reveal an opposing shield or spear through smoke, then lose it behind movement. The POV braces and gets squeezed sideways. No elegant combat, no clean kill, no wide scene. Audio: wood scrape, heavy breath, shield impact, metal and shouting.

scenes.title: Hold in the Smoke
scenes.description: At dusk the POV remains inside the contested position with no clear sense of the battle beyond nearby cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV crouches behind damaged timber with two other exhausted soldiers, breathing hard while arrows and distant fighting continue beyond the smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV crouched inside a smoky damaged earthwork at dusk, two exhausted Cao soldiers within arm's reach, broken timber and shield edges framing the view, dust and smoke hiding the wider battlefield, no victory tableau.
scenes.videoPrompt: End close and unresolved. Stay crouched behind damaged timber with two nearby soldiers filling much of the frame. The chest camera moves subtly with exhausted breathing. A distant impact makes everyone flinch, but nobody poses or celebrates. Do not reveal the battlefield or show a victory panorama. Audio: breathing, wood, arrows, distant fighting and wind. No music.

continuityEndFrame.visibility: wider battle still hidden by smoke
